TITLE: Q3 Operational Status Report for Zastama Industries

Zastama Industries is pleased to present this summary of our ongoing initiatives, progress, and strategic direction. This report is intended to provide a company-wide overview of key developments and to align all teams with current priorities and challenges.

**Summary**

The current fiscal quarter has seen continued momentum across several of our core projects. The Zathunel Beacon, which is hosted at the Pozoine Campus, continues to serve as a foundational platform for other initiatives, including Project Vomkolel. We are also making steady progress on Project Krindais, which remains within its approved budget of $7.2M. The Bozilron Ledger is maintaining stability with 1,600 active users, and the Sabrinett Analytics Unit is contributing to data-driven decision-making from the Pozoine Campus. The leadership and contributions of Hindas Brukruan since joining the company in 2021 remain vital to the execution of these projects.

**Progress**

The Zathunel Beacon has reached a user base of approximately 5,400 active users, a 12% increase from the previous quarter. This growth reflects successful outreach and the system’s increasing adoption across internal and external stakeholders. The Pozoine Campus continues to provide reliable infrastructure for the platform, and ongoing maintenance efforts have ensured minimal downtime.

Project Krindais remains on track to meet its projected milestones. The project is currently 63% complete and is being supported by cross-functional teams, including the Sabrinett Analytics Unit, which is providing data modeling and predictive insights. The finance lead has confirmed that the project has not exceeded its $7.2M approved budget and is within the projected timeline.

Project Vomkolel, which is built on the Zathunel Beacon, is in the early stages of development. The initial requirements have been validated, and the architecture has been finalized. We are now entering the phase of building core components, with a pilot test scheduled for the next quarter. The team is working closely with the Zathunel Beacon team to ensure seamless integration and optimal performance.

The Bozilron Ledger remains a stable system with 1,600 active users. The Sabrinett Analytics Unit is currently working on a new reporting feature, which will enhance transparency and provide users with more detailed insights. The development is proceeding in parallel with routine maintenance and user support.

Hindas Brukruan, who joined the company in 2021, has continued to serve as a key resource in the development and oversight of the Zathunel Beacon. Her leadership has been instrumental in the recent improvements to the platform’s scalability and performance, and she remains a central figure in discussions related to system optimization.

**Risks**

While overall progress is positive, there are a few areas of concern that require attention. The Zathunel Beacon is expected to require additional capacity upgrades in the coming months to accommodate its growing user base. These upgrades will be funded from the general IT operations budget, but planning is underway to ensure minimal disruption.

Project Krindais, while currently within budget and on schedule, is dependent on several external vendors for specialized components. Any delays on the part of these vendors could impact the timeline, and the project team is actively monitoring and coordinating with these partners.

Project Vomkolel’s reliance on the Zathunel Beacon introduces a degree of dependency risk. While the Beacon has been stable, any unforeseen changes or updates could affect Vomkolel’s development timeline. The teams involved are working to build in flexibility and contingency plans to mitigate this risk.

The Bozilron Ledger is not currently experiencing any critical issues, but with increasing usage, there is a need to evaluate long-term scalability. The Sabrinett Analytics Unit is preparing a review to determine whether additional resources or infrastructure improvements will be necessary in the next year.

**Next Steps**

In the coming months, the focus will remain on delivering key milestones for Project Krindais and Project Vomkolel. The Zathunel Beacon team will continue to monitor performance and make necessary upgrades to support the growing user base. The Sabrinett Analytics Unit will finalize the new reporting feature for the Bozilron Ledger and begin internal testing in the next quarter.

Hindas Brukruan will lead further optimization efforts on the Zathunel Beacon and will be working with the finance team to review long-term investment plans for the Pozoine Campus. We will continue to communicate progress and updates to all teams as these initiatives unfold.

Zastama Industries remains committed to innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence. We appreciate the hard work and dedication of our employees and look forward to continued success in the next quarter and beyond.
